WoW: Forever

Rogue

Rogue is a leather-wearing melee class with no self-heal that opens fights from stealth. WoW: Forever · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Written for levelling, 1 to 60. Forever's beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Rogue build has been tested. Blizzard published its first Rogue class deep dive on October 7, and it is the authority on this page: where a guide site or the client still carries an older talent name or effect, Blizzard's text wins. Ability training levels and the percentages below are read from the client, which Blizzard mostly does not publish. The 31-point talents VenomVenomTalentCastInstantCost25 ManaRange100 yd rangeDuration6 secFinishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 sec 2 points: 12 sec 3 points: 15 sec 4 points: 18 sec 5 points: 21 sec and Thousand CutsThousand CutsTalentCastInstant arrive at level 40, so nobody in the beta has used them. Blizzard's caveat covers the rest: "class abilities and talents may continue to evolve throughout the beta test and are subject to additional changes."

Is Rogue for you?

Play Rogue if you like deciding when a fight starts, and you are willing to level a class wearing leather with no self-heal.

Strengths

  • You choose when every fight starts: StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. from level 1, opening with AmbushAmbushSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMeleeAmbush the target, causing 160 damage. from 18
  • StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. and SprintSprintLevel 10 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases the rogue's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Does not break stealth. let you walk past a fight instead of winning it
  • Lockpicking and Poisons are secondary skills now, so neither costs a talent point

Weaknesses

  • Leather armour, no healing, and no way to protect an ally
  • No area damage before Blade FlurryBlade FlurryLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 ManaCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec. at 30, and Wowhead says Subtlety has "no AoE capabilities whatsoever"
  • BackstabBackstabSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9Cast3 sec castCost60 ManaRangeMeleeTeaches Backstab (Rank 9). and AmbushAmbushSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMeleeAmbush the target, causing 160 damage. both need you behind the target, and a weapon swap costs a global cooldown

New to this class?

Is the rotation simple? Icy Veins calls Combat "two buttons" — build combo points, then spend them.

Is it forgiving? No: no self-heal, and leather armour.

What carries you while levelling? StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. from level 1, so you choose every fight.

Does it need a group? No. StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. lets you walk past the fights you would lose.

Every Rogue combat ability trains at its Classic level. What moved is the two utility systems: Lockpicking and Poisons are secondary skills now, like First Aid, and Pick Lock came down to level 1 with them.

Which race

Read this section in proportion. Race is the smallest of the choices on this page, well behind spec, gear and knowing your rotation, and no race is a wrong answer for levelling (ours, not a source's). Racials decide things in PvP, specifically the ones that break crowd control. Will of the ForsakenWill of the ForsakenTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownInstantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (Undead) stops fear, sleep and charm; Escape ArtistEscape ArtistTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration3 secInstantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec. (Gnome) breaks roots and snares; StoneformStoneformTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec. (Dwarf) clears bleeds, poisons and disease. A free trinket slot is worth more than any damage racial below.

Alliance: Human for long fights, on Sword SpecializationSword SpecializationTalent · Rank 1 of 14CastInstantDurationUntil cancelledIncreases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 2% while you have a sword or two-handed sword equipped. at +2% crit, the largest weapon racial. Gnome is the better levelling pick, for Eureka!Eureka!TalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secYour next 3 non-periodic damaging abilities have their Energy cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage. and Escape ArtistEscape ArtistTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration3 secInstantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec..

Horde: Orc, unambiguously. Axe SpecializationAxe SpecializationTalent · Rank 1 of 15CastInstantDurationUntil cancelledIncreases your critical strike chance with all spells and abilities by 1% while you have an axe or a two-handed axe equipped. gives +1% crit, and Rogues can use one-handed axes in Forever, which is new.

Forever changed the answer three ways. Weapon racials became crit racials, Rogues gained one-handed axes, and Hack and SlashHack and SlashTalentCastInstantGives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor. extended the old weapon-specialisation bonus to axes. Your weapon no longer picks your spec for you.

Quality of life

  • The level-20 poison quest is the one thing you must not skip. Reagents come from a poison vendor near your class trainer. In Forever a poison and a sharpening stone or weightstone go on the same weapon at once, where Classic made you choose. Every poison also carries more charges than it did.
  • You need two weapons and a swap macro: a dagger main-hand for AmbushAmbushSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMeleeAmbush the target, causing 160 damage. and BackstabBackstabSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9Cast3 sec castCost60 ManaRangeMeleeTeaches Backstab (Rank 9)., and a slow non-dagger for Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost45 ManaRangeMeleeInflicts normal damage plus 1 to an enemy.. Swapping costs a global cooldown and resets your swing timer.
  • Train the weapon that matches your racial: swords for Human, one-handed axes for Orc.
  • Lockpicking is free money from level 1 now, and pairs with Pick PocketPick PocketLevel 4 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMeleePick the target's pocket. at 4. First Aid is near-mandatory with no self-heal, but you can GougeGougeSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost45 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration4 secInflicts 20 damage to an enemy and stuns it for up to 4 sec. You will automatically stop attacking. Target must be facing you. Any damage received by the stunned target will revive it. or BlindBlindLevel 34 · Spell · NatureCastInstantCost30 ManaRange10 yd rangeCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secBlinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. and bandage mid-fight.
  • DistractDistractLevel 22 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost30 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration10 secThrows a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby enemies and reducing their Stealth detection as if they were 1 level lower for 10 seconds. Does not break stealth. now cuts enemy stealth detection for 10 seconds, which is how you open a SapSapLevel 10 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost65 ManaRangeMeleeDuration25 secIncapacitates the target for up to 25 sec. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage taken will break the effect. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time. Does not break Stealth. on one of a pair. Blizzard's own warning for PvP: "player enemies will now know there is a Rogue nearby to look for."
  • A current beta bug, not intended design: enemies can Parry and Block from behind if you stand too close. Blizzard's workaround is to not crowd the target. Leave a step of room before you open with BackstabBackstabSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9Cast3 sec castCost60 ManaRangeMeleeTeaches Backstab (Rank 9)..

At level 60

Unknown. There is no tested 51-point build, no stat weights, and no answer on whether Assassination's poison identity, Combat's Hack and SlashHack and SlashTalentCastInstantGives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor. or Subtlety's Rupture engine wins. One major site declines even to publish a stat priority. Blizzard states the class has "the highest potential single-target melee damage in the game." Nothing has tested that. Raids open December 9.
